verdict.reasoning: The object describes one coherent liquidity-sweep reversal framework around the premarket 3:00 a.m. to 9:30 a.m. high/low: mark the range, wait for price to briefly break above or below a boundary, then fail/reclaim that level with volume and enter after confirmation, with the stop on the opposite side of the entry candle. The mentions of sweeps 'below or above the level' are context-selected mirror alternatives—short after a failed sweep of the high or long after a reclaimed sweep of the low—not simultaneous requirements. And while the transcript references breakout and retest as other ways to trade the same levels, the object’s actual reversal trigger is not co-required with its opposite, so a single trade instance can execute coherently.
